approval_required_for: Any later RTL, exact-board wrapper, testbench, pipeline, memory-layout, runtime-ABI, checkpoint, stimulus, target-reference, numeric-policy/tolerance, or major-template change proposed after successful reconciliation. No approval is required for the present read-only reconciliation action.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep Stage8 blocked; preserve active contamination_barrier.0329, .0330, .0331, .0341 through .0361 and open retry_request.0136, .0140 through .0146. Record the implementation gap for planned_tool.exact_board_lifecycle_cctg_reconciliation. Do not run VCS or dependent board checks, replay lower layers, edit sources, relax numeric policy, or promote.
executable_actions.rationale: This is the sole authorized current-layer action. Reconcile the contradictory lifecycle ordering declaration against immutable exact-board evidence and the policy requiring an accepted input handshake before kernel lifecycle start. The multi-agent framework lacks an implemented exact-board lifecycle reconciliation capability, so planned_tool.exact_board_lifecycle_cctg_reconciliation must be implemented and used. The operation is record-only: it must not edit RTL, the board wrapper, testbench sources, loader, scheduler, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, tolerance, or weight bindings, and must not start VCS.

observations: The exact user-supplied board wrapper identity and simulation-source closure passed with board_source_identity sha256=37ebe27a4d9293741131ba64432dc6e71a10c10570780d03dbec910eee555e66, but the exact-board functional VCS run did not pass. It accepted all 1792 kernel ingress beats for 16 tokens and accepted zero ready egress beats; therefore no board functional, numeric, data-order, AXI protocol, DDR-roundtrip, lifecycle, semantic-evidence, or complete board-scope weight-consumption pass exists.

The current CCTG trace flags kernel_start_precedes_stage0_input at first ingress, while hierarchical_learning_context requires an accepted input handshake before lifecycle start and the immutable trace records direct ingress before the observed start event. This is an observation-contract inconsistency requiring reconciliation, not evidence sufficient to modify RTL, the exact wrapper, loader, or scheduler.

The completed connected-kernel capability is hash-bound pass evidence: 416 accepted trace records, complete 1792-beat ingress and egress, terminal egress last, and boundary liveness pass. Its elastic variable-latency ordering and cross-token-overlap invariant remains closed. No new current trace explicitly contradicts a named certified invariant, so neither connected-kernel nor operator-leaf replay is authorized.

Active SACG contamination barriers remain current downstream-consumption and promotion blockers: contamination_barrier.0329, .0330, .0331, .0341 through .0361. They allow rejected artifacts only as planning/debug evidence, not validated design inputs.

Open retry requests retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, .0144, .0145, and .0146 require bounded repair completion followed by Stage7 verification before promotion. They do not authorize a VCS rerun before the explicitly required reconciliation action.

The target-model expected output is bound to target-model inference and the exact wrapper/testbench hashes are immutable; numeric comparison was not run because the board execution did not complete. Reconciliation must preserve checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, numeric policy, tolerance, tensor binding evidence, stream order, memory-layout evidence, runtime ABI facts, and board-source hashes.
proposed_actions: Implement and execute only repair.reconcile_exact_board_lifecycle_cctg_observation_contract as a read-only, hash-bound reconciliation of the existing exact-board records.

Require the reconciliation output to retain every existing boundary valid/ready state, sent/received count, first/last payload digest, direct egress observation, immutable source identity, target-reference binding, numeric policy, and closed connected-kernel certificate.

If reconciliation cannot establish a lifecycle-consistent interpretation from the immutable artifacts, retain all active barriers and retry requests and remain blocked; do not modify sources or launch any simulator.

Only after reconciliation passes its acceptance checkers may the board scope return to Stage7 for its prescribed exact-wrapper rerun sequence; reconciliation alone never promotes backend, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime.
risks: Treating the zero-output frontier or the start-order diagnostic as a proven hardware root cause could cause an unsupported DUT, wrapper, loader, or scheduler modification.

Launching VCS, dependent multilayer-functional, deadlock/liveness, AXI-protocol, DDR-roundtrip, or board-semantic checks before reconciliation violates the authorized repair order and cannot close the active retry requests.

Replaying the connected kernel would violate its closed hash-bound capability evidence unless a newly produced current board trace directly contradicts a named certified invariant with hash-bound lifecycle, ingress, egress, and causal-boundary evidence.

Changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy/tolerance, semantic testbench contract, tensor catalog/consumption scope, data order, memory layout, runtime ABI, or exact wrapper source hashes would contaminate this repair loop.

The required exact-board lifecycle reconciliation capability is not implemented in the grounding registry; no reconciliation may be claimed without the planned tool's hash-bound output and listed checker evidence.
output.summary: Fail closed at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system. The only authorized next causally distinct action is a hash-bound, record-only reconciliation of the exact-board lifecycle/CCTG observation contract. It must resolve the conflict between the first-ingress-before-start diagnostic and the live policy requiring an accepted input handshake before lifecycle start; it is not an RTL-root-cause claim, a board pass, or permission to rerun VCS. The certified connected-kernel replay is closed and must not be reopened.
